reader.requirement: At --std 85, after any unsuccessful START on an indexed file (invalid key '23' on any key of reference and any relational operator, the absent-OPTIONAL '23', the open-mode '47'), the file position indicator must indicate no valid next record, so the next sequential READ (READ NEXT in dynamic access, READ in sequential access) is unsuccessful with '46' (IX.1.3.4 status 46 item 1) until a successful START, random READ or OPEN repositions; the key of reference is undefined (not observable except that a later START/READ establishes its own).
reader.edition-search: grep -n Edition over src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/*.cs: the connector carries Edition (FileConnector#Edition, set from ctx.Data.DialectLevel at registration in KeyedIoEmitter) but the only switches are SharingFacilityInEffect, IndexedReadPreviousAfterOpenAtEnd (READ PREVIOUS only), IndexedDuplicateKeyStatusSequentialOnly (the '02' after a successful read), RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError, CloseWithLock and report-writer rows; none lies on IndexedConnector#Start -> StartFail -> Unsuccessful -> InvalidateFilePosition or on SequentialReadGuard's '46' arm. KeyedIoEmitter#EmitStart has no Edition/Version/Dialect reference. The path is edition-blind: 85 takes the latest edition's code.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb359 covers prime-key START KEY > on dynamic access and '47' in OUTPUT mode; not exercised: START on an ALTERNATE key, ACCESS SEQUENTIAL (READ without NEXT), KEY = with a short (generic) operand, the absent-OPTIONAL '23', START on a closed file, and the reposition by a random READ after the failure.

reader.notes: Every failing exit of IndexedConnector#Start returns through Unsuccessful, whose InvalidateFilePosition (sealed override in KeyedConnector) clears FpiValid and arms LastReadUnsuccessful; SequentialReadGuard answers '46' first. Probes on alternate keys, sequential access, generic keys, closed and absent-optional files all printed '46' after the failure.
